title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
alternative_titles: ゼルダの伝説 時のオカリナ
description: Link explores Hyrule to stop Ganondorf from seizing the Triforce, traveling between childhood and adulthood while solving dungeon puzzles and battling enemies with weapons, tools, and ocarina melodies.

player_sentiment.summary: The sampled community discussion praises the dungeons, soundtrack, atmosphere, and story, while some participants find the controls and camera dated, equipment changes cumbersome, and Hyrule Field sparse; these opinions are not a representative consensus.
positives: Engaging story and sense of adventure
negatives: Controls and camera feel dated to some players
Hyrule Field feels sparse to some players

similar_games: The Legend of Zelda: Majora’s Mask
